title: Spot urine osmolality does not establish added nocturia prediction across two independently sampled NHANES releases
abstract: In 4,151 NHANES 2011–2012 complete-case adults, adding spot urine osmolality to a source-fitted demographic, kidney-function, glycemia and urinary-creatinine model did not establish incremental nocturia prediction: weighted Brier gain -0.0001544 (95% source-and-target PSU refit interval -0.0022312 to 0.0010964).
